title: Material File
content: File Extension: .bgsm, .bgem A material file is used to define the visual appearance of a Model File. The file includes Texture File paths as well as other properties that control visuals. Material files are specified by creating a Material Swap record in a Data File. Tooling: - A standard text editor can create and edit material files. - Material Editor by Ousnius - There are other software projects that provide tooling for working material files. See Also: - Game Files Category - Material Swap - Model File - Texture File
